title: Inquisitiveness

inlines.v: INQUIS'ITIVENESS, noun The disposition to obtain information by questioning others, or by researches into facts, causes or principles; curiosity to learn what is not known. The works of nature furnish ample matter for the inquisitiveness of the human mind.
